notes.what: The Indian plate-format tables plate_rules.py runs on. Editing this file changes what the worker and the AI service accept, correct and decode — no code change. Both copies (anpr_worker/ and ai_service/vms_face/services/) must stay byte-identical; tests/test_plate_rules.py checks it where both are visible.
notes.loading: plate_rules.load_formats(): $ANPR_PLATE_FORMATS, else this file beside plate_rules.py, else $ANPR_BYTETRACK_DIR/plate_formats.json (default /srv/app/anpr_worker — how the vms_face copy finds the worker's file), else the built-in plate_rules._DEFAULTS. A key left out keeps its built-in value; a file with a wrong shape is skipped whole with one warning.
notes.state_codes: Every state / UT registration code that may open a plate. Old and new codes both stay valid (OR/OD, UA/UK, TS/TG) — the old fleet is still on the road. TG: Telangana's registration series since 2024; before 2026-09-02 it was missing, so every TG plate was rejected as a fake state (a false rejection). TS kept for plates issued 2014-2024.
notes.regexes: The structural regexes (PLATE_RE, BH_RE) stay in plate_rules.py — the shape of an Indian plate is not configuration. The state-code check is separate from them, so adding a state here is all a new series needs.
notes.templates: Position templates per string length, most common first — correct_plate tries them in this order. L = letter slot, D = digit slot, B/H = the fixed Bharat-series literals. No 7-char template on purpose: it mostly legitimised OCR noise (seen live: KA54339).
notes.template_prior: Log-prior per plate SHAPE, added to the OCR log-prob by the constrained decoder in plate_ocr.py, so a rare shape that fits the raw glyphs (GJ0ZBP5367) no longer beats the common shape that needs one confusion fix (GJ02BP5367). LLDDLDDDD (the single-letter series: GJ32 K 6137) is -0.3, not -0.7, since 3 Sep 2026: that series is everyday traffic on Gujarat district cameras, and the milder prior measured never worse on 154 + 111 held-out crops (+1 exact).
notes.two_digit_district_states: States whose RTO codes are always two digits: a 1-digit-district template there is almost certainly a misread and gets one_digit_district_penalty in the decoder (-5 outweighs a 0.96-vs-0.01 glyph gap; the raw read survives as an alternative regardless).
notes.to_digit_to_letter: Position-aware OCR confusions: in a DIGIT slot an O becomes 0, in a LETTER slot a 0 becomes O. Validation never applies these — only correct_plate / validate_or_correct do.
notes.state_fix: Whole-state-code fixes for a misread first character (WH -> MH), tried before the templates.
notes.code_prior_weight: Weight of the per-camera registration-code prior (state+district histogram of confirmed plates on that camera) inside the constrained decode.
